name: National Quantum Initiative
summary: Created by the National Quantum Initiative Act (Pub. L. 115-368), which coordinates federal quantum research across NIST, NSF and DOE and set up the DOE National Quantum Information Science Research Centers. Executive Order 14413 (June 2026) orders an updated national strategy.
note: The $1.2 billion figure is widely reported but wasn't stated on the source page checked.

name: National Quantum Strategy
summary: Ten-year plan with five quantum missions, including quantum computers and networks, quantum sensing and navigation, run through UKRI and the National Quantum Computing Centre.

name: Quantum Flagship and Quantum Europe Strategy
summary: The EU's research flagship for quantum technologies. The Quantum Europe Strategy (July 2025) aims to make the EU a quantum leader by 2030 and announced a Quantum Act.
note: The €1 billion Flagship figure is widely reported but wasn't confirmed from the page checked.

name: Action Concept for Quantum Technologies
summary: Federal plan adopted by the cabinet in April 2023, aiming for a universal quantum computer of at least 100 qubits by 2026.

name: National Strategy for Quantum Technologies
summary: Announced by President Macron in January 2021, covering quantum computing, sensing, communications and enabling technologies.
source_name: French Ministry of Higher Education and Research

name: Quantum Delta NL
funding: €615 million from the National Growth Fund
summary: National program for quantum computing, networks and sensing, built around hubs in Delft, Amsterdam, Leiden, Eindhoven and Twente.

name: National Quantum Strategy
summary: Launched in January 2023 with missions in quantum computing, quantum communications and quantum sensors.

name: National Quantum Strategy
funding: A$940 million with Queensland for PsiQuantum (2024)
summary: Strategy published in 2023. In 2024 the federal and Queensland governments committed A$940 million to PsiQuantum to build a fault-tolerant quantum computer in Brisbane.
source_name: Department of Industry, Science and Resources

name: National Quantum Mission
summary: Approved by the Union Cabinet in April 2023 to build intermediate-scale quantum computers, quantum communication, sensing and materials, through four thematic hubs.

name: Quantum Science and Technology Strategy
summary: Plan from the Ministry of Science and ICT to make Korea a quantum economy hub by 2035, with public and private investment.

name: National Quantum Strategy
summary: Announced in May 2024 to fund quantum research, talent and a national quantum processor initiative.
